lines.en: label makicamp2:
scene makiactualfish1
After making my way back to the campground, I find Maki sitting beside a lake that looks more like a large puddle in a rare moment of somewhat quiet contemplation for her.
lines.zh: 回到营地后，我发现 Maki 坐在一个与其说是湖、不如说是大水坑的旁边，难得地陷入了某种程度的安静沉思。

lines.en: And the only reason it’s {i}somewhat{/i} and not {i}genuinely{/i} quiet contemplation is the fact that I can hear Haruka chatting up Sara and Ami inside of their tent not that far from here.
lines.zh: 之所以说是「{i}某种程度{/i}」而不是{i}真正{/i}的安静沉思，是因为我能听见 Haruka 在离这儿不远的帐篷里跟 Sara 和 Ami 聊得正欢。

lines.en: But, not wanting to intrude (And also being given the rare opportunity to hang out with Maki in an area where she can not immediately reach for a plastic horse penis), I can’t help but indulge and make my way over.
lines.zh: 不过，我不想打扰她们（而且这也是个难得的机会，能在一个她没法立刻伸手去抓塑料马屌的地方跟 Maki 待着），于是我忍不住纵容自己，走了过去。

lines.en: She notices me immediately and gazes back with eyes that scream both “I have no idea what I’m doing” and “I’m glad you came over because I was bored as hell.”
lines.zh: 她立刻注意到了我，回望我的眼神同时在喊两句话：「我完全不知道自己在干什么」和「我很高兴你过来了，因为我无聊死了」。

lines.en: : Hey! I’m glad you came over because I was bored as hell. And also, I have no idea what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 嘿！我很高兴你过来了，因为我无聊死了。而且，我完全不知道自己在干什么。

lines.en: Cool. I guess I know her better than I thought.
lines.zh: 酷。看来我比自己以为的更了解她。

lines.en: : Why bother fishing if you have no idea what you’re doing?
lines.zh: : 既然不知道自己在干什么，何必还要钓鱼？

lines.en: scene makiactualfish2

: Thought I’d try learning. But apparently, this isn’t something you can just sit down and do. But hey, not much else is going on right now. So maybe this will bring me {i}closer to nature{/i} or something like that.
lines.zh: : 我想着试试学着钓。不过显然这不是坐下来就能干的事。可是嘿，眼下也没别的事可做。所以也许这能让我{i}离大自然近一点{/i}之类的。

lines.en: : I didn’t take you as the type of woman who’d want to be closer to nature in any capacity.
lines.zh: : 我看你不像是那种在任何意义上都想亲近自然的女人。

lines.en: : And I didn’t take you as the type of man who’d go out of his way to bring his niece camping just because he thought it might make her happy.
lines.zh: : 我也看你不像是那种会特地带侄女来露营、只因为觉得这也许能让她开心的男人。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish1
: But I’m glad that you are.
lines.zh: : 不过我很高兴你就是这种人。

lines.en: : It’ll make packing up all of our gear a lot easier tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: : 这样明早收拾装备会轻松很多。

lines.en: : Is there an extra chair I could set up next to you?
lines.zh: : 还有多余的椅子吗？我可以搬一把到你旁边。

lines.en: : Ooooh, is it bondage time?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，是绑缚时间到了吗？

lines.en: : You know damn well that the word is “bonding.”
lines.zh: : 你他妈明明知道那个词是「增进感情」。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish2
: I have no idea what you’re talking about. But yes, there are a few extra chairs in my trunk. You just might have to move a few things out of the way first. Only a handful of them bite, though.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。不过没错，我后备箱里是有几把多余的椅子。你可能得先把几样东西挪开。只有少部分会咬人而已。

lines.en: : There are toys for all sorts of people nowadays, aren’t there?
lines.zh: : 现在真是各种人都有各种玩具了，对吧？

lines.en: : They’re the backbone keeping society propped up and I refuse to believe otherwise.
lines.zh: : 它们是支撑整个社会的脊梁，我拒绝相信别的说法。

lines.en: scene black
: You know, I can’t say I disagree. But I feel like your thoughts on this matter are a lot more passionate than mine, so I’m just going to dig through your trunk now.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我倒也不能说不同意。不过我觉得你对这件事的看法比我要有激情得多，所以我现在就去翻你的后备箱了。

lines.en: : Jeez, Akira. At least lube yourself up first. That’s a sensitive spot and I’m a fragile young woman.
lines.zh: : 天哪，Akira。至少先给自己上点润滑吧。那地方很敏感，而我可是个脆弱的年轻女人。

lines.en: I ignore Maki’s somewhat flirtatious prodding for what I imagine is the millionth time in my life as I make my way over to her car.
lines.zh: 我走向她的车，把 Maki 那点带调情意味的撩拨忽略掉——这辈子我大概已经忽略过一百万次了。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish3
I prop the chair up beside her and sink down into it, digging my heels into the grass to prevent it from slipping away and sending me face first into the water and then subsequently her hook.
lines.zh: 我在她旁边把椅子支好、坐下去，脚跟用力嵌进草里，免得椅子滑走，让我一头栽进水里，然后再撞上她的鱼钩。

lines.en: She looks at me again and pauses for a moment, but I can’t discern what her gaze is saying this time. So I just look back at her. And I wonder if she’s trying to figure out what {i}my{/i} eyes are saying.
lines.zh: 她又看了我一眼，停顿片刻，可这次我读不懂她的目光在说什么。于是我只是回望着她。而我怀疑她是不是也在试图弄清{i}我的{/i}眼睛在说什么。

lines.en: I get compliments on them a lot, but I’ve never understood why. And, more often than not, it leads me to believe that the words themselves are empty and only exist to curry favor with a potential mate.
lines.zh: 我常常被人夸这双眼睛，却从来不明白为什么。而且多半时候，这让我觉得那些话本身是空的，存在的唯一目的就是讨好一个潜在配偶。

lines.en: There’s none of that here, though. We’re just two confused adults who happen to exist at the same time, fighting our own battles and pretending to be stronger than we actually are.
lines.zh: 不过这里没有那一套。我们只是两个恰好同时存在的迷茫成年人，各自打着各自的仗，假装比真正的自己更坚强。

lines.en: It’s the illusion that matters, after all. Because things are only real once you can see them. And if you can never see {i}pain,{/i} you can trick yourself into believing it doesn’t exist.
lines.zh: 毕竟重要的是那个假象。因为事物只有在你能看见的时候才是真实的。而如果你永远看不见{i}痛苦{/i}，你就能骗自己相信它并不存在。

lines.en: I know why Maki’s fishing.
lines.zh: 我知道 Maki 为什么在钓鱼。

lines.en: And I can promise you that nature has nothing to do with it.
lines.zh: 而且我可以向你保证，那跟大自然毫无关系。

lines.en: : You know...you’re a good guy, Akira.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……你是个好人，Akira。

lines.en: You’re only saying that because you still don’t know I’m screwing your daughter.
lines.zh: 你这么说，只是因为你还不知道我在操你女儿。

lines.en: {b}i’m glad you said it because i was going to if you didn’t.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}我很高兴你说了，因为你要是不说我也准备说。{/b}

lines.en: Why not make me say it out loud then? That’s a thing you can do, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 那你为什么不让我把它说出口？那种事你做得到吧？

lines.en: {b}beep boop bop. too far out of service area. waiting for more bars. try back later.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}哔啵哔。超出服务区太远。正在等待更多信号。请稍后再试。{/b}

lines.en: So I can get away from you if I just stay out here?
lines.zh: 那只要我待在外头，就能躲开你了？

lines.en: {b}maybe. but then you’d run out of cumsluts and drown yourself in the river and i don’t know how to swim.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}也许吧。不过那样你就会耗尽精液婊，然后淹死在河里，而我不会游泳。{/b}

lines.en: : Are you always this quiet after getting a compliment? Or are you still just trying to figure out how to respond?
lines.zh: : 你每次被夸之后都这么沉默吗？还是说你还在想该怎么回应？

lines.en: : Sorry. Just...thinking.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。只是……在想事情。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish4
: I get it. That’s kind of why I’m out here trying new things in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我懂。这大概也是我一开始跑出来尝试新东西的原因。

lines.en: : Masahiro liked fishing. He’d take Makoto out with him from time to time.
lines.zh: : Masahiro 喜欢钓鱼。他偶尔会带着 Makoto 一起去。

lines.en: : Said it was his way of {i}calming down.{/i} But he was always pretty mild-mannered to begin with.
lines.zh: : 说那是他让自己{i}平静下来{/i}的方式。不过他本来就脾气相当温和。

lines.en: : Guess you never really know what’s going through someone’s head, though. Like, for all I know, maybe he was miserable? Maybe he only needed to “calm down” because I was stressing him out?
lines.zh: : 不过你大概永远也不会真的知道别人脑子里在想什么。比如，说不定他其实过得很痛苦？说不定他之所以需要「平静一下」，只是因为我把他搞得压力很大？

lines.en: : I doubt that was it. You might be weird, but you don’t seem like a {i}stressful{/i} partner.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑不是这样。你可能是怪了点，但不像是那种{i}让人有压力{/i}的伴侣。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish5
: You’re probably right. Or at least that’s what I’ll keep telling myself since it’s not like I can really {i}ask{/i} anymore.
lines.zh: : 你大概是对的。至少我会一直这么告诉自己，反正我也真的没法再{i}问{/i}他了。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish4
: But even if he’s gone now, I still feel like I can {i}connect{/i} with him if I do things like this. So I guess it’s less about being “one with nature” and more about being “one with dead husband.”
lines.zh: : 不过就算他已经不在了，我觉得只要做些这样的事，还是能跟他产生某种{i}联结{/i}。所以我想，与其说是「与自然合一」，不如说是「与死去的丈夫合一」。

lines.en: : That was actually really sweet up until the end.
lines.zh: : 其实在结尾之前都还挺感人的。

lines.en: : Yeah, that made me sound kind of like a necrophiliac, didn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是啊，那让我听起来有点像恋尸癖，对吧？

lines.en: : That’s most assuredly not where my mind went, but it’s a very {i}Maki{/i} way of interpreting it, so I guess I’m not surprised.
lines.zh: : 我绝对没有往那方面想，不过这确实很 {i}Maki{/i} 式的解读方式，所以我也就不意外了。

lines.en: : Do you think you’d ever bone a zombie if you were given the chance?
lines.zh: : 如果有机会，你觉得你会上一个丧尸吗？

lines.en: scene makiactualfish6
: Is that really what we’re going to talk about? I was expecting more of a serious conversation after the way this talk started.
lines.zh: : 我们真的要聊这个吗？看这谈话的开头，我还以为会是个正经话题。

lines.en: : Can we not have a serious conversation about the ethics of having sex with a dead body?
lines.zh: : 我们就不能正经讨论一下跟尸体做爱的伦理问题吗？

lines.en: : I take it that means you would?
lines.zh: : 那我是不是可以理解为，你会？

lines.en: scene makiactualfish7
: I’m not sure, actually. Like, can zombies even get boners? Is it just {i}always{/i} hard because of the rigor mortis?
lines.zh: : 其实我不确定。比如，丧尸还能勃起吗？是尸僵导致的{i}一直{/i}硬着吗？

lines.en: : Maki, are you doing okay? Because I can leave you alone if you’re only doing this right now to connect with your husband. I wasn’t trying to interrupt that.
lines.zh: : Maki，你还好吗？如果你现在做这些只是为了跟丈夫产生联结，我可以不打扰你。我不是有意打断的。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish8

: Thank you for that...but I’m fine. I’ll probably just stick to fishing in porn games and connect with Masahiro in other ways. Like eating his favorite foods or...recommending elderly porn to my customers.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你这么想……不过我没事。我大概还是只在色情游戏里钓鱼，然后用别的方式跟 Masahiro 联结。比如吃他最爱吃的菜，或者……给顾客推荐老年人色情片。

lines.en: : This is not a thing I ever needed to know or learn, so thanks for that.
lines.zh: : 这可真是我从不需要知道、也不需要了解的事，谢了啊。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish9

: Dead men tell no tales, so their widows must sing their glories instead. Even if their glories involve fishing and watching grandma take a massive dong up her cooter like she’s back in her twenties again.
lines.zh: : 死人不会说话，所以他们的遗孀只能替他们歌颂功德。哪怕那些功德包括钓鱼，以及看着老奶奶把一根巨屌塞进她的老穴里，就像她回到了二十岁一样。

lines.en: : You miss him, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你想他，对吧？

lines.en: scene makiactualfish10
: Yeah.
: But that’s not something I expect to ever go away. I mean...how {i}can{/i} it?
lines.zh: : 可我不指望这种感觉会消失。我是说……怎么{i}能{/i}消失呢？

lines.en: : Falling in love is, like...it’s something that changes a person. It’s not a thing you can just fall {i}out{/i} of once one side isn’t there anymore.
lines.zh: : 坠入爱河这种事……是能改变一个人的。它不是那种只要一方不在了，你就能{i}说不爱就不爱{/i}的东西。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish11
: That’s okay, though. I {i}want{/i} to keep those feelings because I really {i}did{/i} love that mild-mannered elder fucker. And- you know what, Akira? If he was a zombie, I’d still let him hit it.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。我{i}想{/i}留住这些感情，因为我真的{i}爱过{/i}那个脾气温和的老混蛋。而且——你知道吗，Akira？如果他变成了丧尸，我还是会让他来一发。

lines.en: : I’m putting a lot of faith in rigor mortis right now though and I hope you know that.
lines.zh: : 不过我现在可是把赌注都压在尸僵上了，希望你明白这一点。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish12
: Akira?...
lines.zh: : Akira？……

lines.en: : Do you have, like...advice?
lines.zh: : 你能不能……给我点建议？

lines.en: : For...for parenting, you mean? I thought that’s why Sara-
lines.zh: : 你是说……育儿方面的？我以为 Sara 就是为了这个-

lines.en: : For moving on after losing someone you love.
lines.zh: : 是关于失去所爱之人后，该怎么走下去。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish13
: I know we haven’t really, like...{i}talked{/i} ever since I started coming back to the shop. But that’s kind of what caused this whole shitty situation in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我知道自从我重新开始去店里之后，我们其实……没怎么{i}聊{/i}过。可这整团烂摊子追根究底就是那么来的。

lines.en: : And seeing you out here doing things like fishing just because your husband used to do it makes me want to try and kind of...take matters into my own hands as well.
lines.zh: : 而看到你在这儿做着钓鱼之类的事，只因为你丈夫过去常做，让我也想试着……自己主动做点什么。

lines.en: : Like, Ami’s not the only person who I hope this trip helps out. But I’m so torn between wanting to feel better and thinking I don’t {i}deserve{/i} to that I have no way of knowing what to actually {i}do.{/i}
lines.zh: : 比如说，Ami 不是我唯一希望这趟旅行能帮到的人。可我在「想让自己好起来」和「觉得自己{i}不配{/i}好起来」之间撕裂着，根本不知道该怎么{i}做{/i}。

lines.en: : All I know is that everything I see reminds me of someone I can’t let go of. And I was wondering if you had any, like...advice on what I should be latching onto or not.
lines.zh: : 我只知道，我看见的一切都让我想起一个我放不下的人。而我想知道你有没有……什么建议，告诉我该抓住什么、又不该抓住什么。

lines.en: : Do the others know?
lines.zh: : 其他人知道吗？

lines.en: : Not yet. And I didn’t even plan on telling {i}you{/i} until a minute ago. I just can’t help but admire how...{i}resilient{/i} you are.
lines.zh: : 还不知道。而且一分钟之前我都还没打算告诉{i}你{/i}。我只是忍不住佩服……你有多{i}坚韧{/i}。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish14
: There’s nothing I can say that will make you feel any better.
lines.zh: : 我说什么都没法让你好受一点。

lines.en: : Yeah...I figured as much.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我猜也是。

lines.en: : It sucks, I know. And, just like with Makoto, I wish there was {i}something{/i} I can do. But if there’s anything I’ve unfortunately learned lately, it’s that moving past something like this entirely comes down to you.
lines.zh: : 这很操蛋，我知道。而且跟 Makoto 那次一样，我真希望自己能做点{i}什么{/i}。不过如果最近我有什么不幸学到的东西，那就是：能不能彻底跨过这种事，全看你自己。

lines.en: : No matter what you tell me, I’ll never understand the way you saw the person you’re referring to. Just like how you’ll never understand what I had with Masahiro.
lines.zh: : 不管你告诉我什么，我永远无法理解你眼中的那个人是什么样子。就像你也永远无法理解我和 Masahiro 之间有过什么。

lines.en: : All we can do is relate to one another and share in each other’s experience and...maybe that helps a little. But it pales in comparison to the pain that returns when all those precious memories start flooding in.
lines.zh: : 我们能做的只有彼此共情、分享各自的经历……也许那有一点点用。可当那些珍贵的回忆一涌而上、痛苦卷土重来时，那点用处就微不足道了。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish15
: It’s going to hurt for the rest of your life.
lines.zh: : 这会疼上一辈子。

lines.en: : But there are {i}other{/i} things that can keep you grounded.
lines.zh: : 但还有{i}别的{/i}东西能让你稳住。

lines.en: : That’s probably why I’m putting so much of myself into Ami right now.
lines.zh: : 大概这就是为什么我现在把这么多自己都押在 Ami 身上。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish16
: That is illegal in several ways, good sir.
lines.zh: : 先生，那在好几个方面都是违法的。

lines.en: : Maki, come on.
lines.zh: : Maki，拜托。

lines.en: : On or in? Because pulling out of Ami makes things a little more socially acceptable, but {i}still.{/i} Not a smart move, man.
lines.zh: : 是在上面还是在里面？因为从 Ami 体内拔出来，在社会观感上稍微好一点，{i}但也就好那么一点{/i}。不明智啊，老兄。

lines.en: : Just...forget I even said anything.
lines.zh: : 就……当我什么都没说。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish17
: I’m just trying to lighten the mood, Akira. I know you and Ami don’t have {i}that{/i} kind of relationship.
lines.zh: : 我只是想缓和一下气氛，Akira。我知道你和 Ami 不是{i}那种{/i}关系。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
Yeah. It’s much worse than you could probably imagine.
lines.zh: 是啊。比你大概能想象到的还要糟得多。

lines.en: : I understand exactly what you mean when you say you’re putting all of yourself into Ami because that’s exactly what I’m doing with Makoto. Just...in a way that’s very hands-off and doesn’t annoy her.
lines.zh: : 你说你把全部自己都押在 Ami 身上，我完全明白你的意思，因为我对 Makoto 做的正是同样的事。只是……我采取的是放手式，不会惹她烦。

lines.en: : You think {i}your{/i} happiness will come from her, right? So you want {i}her{/i} to feel better because that will make {i}you{/i} feel like you’re doing something right.
lines.zh: : 你觉得{i}你的{/i}幸福会来自她，对吧？所以你希望{i}她{/i}好起来，因为那样{i}你{/i}就会觉得自己做对了什么。

lines.en: : I guess you grasp the situation a lot better than you let on.
lines.zh: : 看来你对情况的理解比你表现出来的要深得多。

lines.en: : Because it’s the {i}same{/i} situation, Akira. We’re parents. {i}Both{/i} of us. Not just me.
lines.zh: : 因为这是{i}同一种{/i}处境，Akira。我们是家长。{i}我们俩{/i}都是。不只是我。

lines.en: : I don’t deserve to be called a parent.
lines.zh: : 我不配被称为家长。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish18
: And I {i}do?!{/i} I didn’t take up the mantle of “Mom” until my husband passed away. That’s why Makoto has such a hard time even {i}seeing{/i} me as a proper mother.
lines.zh: : 那我就{i}配了吗{/i}？！我直到丈夫去世才担起「妈妈」这个身份。所以 Makoto 才那么难把我{i}当成{/i}一位真正的母亲。

lines.en: : And...I have no clue who the person you’re talking about is, but maybe that’ll serve as yours and Ami’s prompt for sneaking a bit of normalcy back into your lives.
lines.zh: : 而且……我完全不知道你说的那个人是谁，但也许这正好能成为你和 Ami 的契机，把一点点常态偷偷塞回你们的生活中。

lines.en: : I’m just...not sure if I can do it, Maki.
lines.zh: : 我只是……不确定自己能不能做到，Maki。

lines.en: : Doubting yourself is just part of the process, Akira. No one’s good at this right away. It’s scary having someone else’s life in your hands. {i}Especially{/i} when that person is smart.
lines.zh: : 怀疑自己本来就是这个过程的一部分，Akira。没人一上来就擅长这个。把别人的命握在手里是很可怕的。{i}尤其是{/i}那个人还很聪明的时候。

lines.en: : And yeah, Ami might not be {i}Makoto{/i}-smart. But I’ve heard about what happened to her parents and I can almost assure you that sort of event would make her at least {i}emotionally{/i} mature.
lines.zh: : 而且没错，Ami 也许没有 {i}Makoto{/i} 那么聪明。但我听说过她父母的事，我几乎可以保证，那种经历至少会让她在{i}情感上{/i}变得成熟。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’m not so sure about that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这个我可不太确定。

lines.en: : That’s not really a thing we ever talk about in our house.
lines.zh: : 那在我们家基本是个从不提起的话题。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish19
: Mm...so {i}that’s{/i} the way it is.
lines.zh: : 嗯……原来{i}是这么回事{/i}。

lines.en: : Sorry. I didn’t know.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我不知道。

lines.en: : There’s nothing to apologize for. I just have to figure out a way to make this work on my own. Learning coping techniques from someone else who experienced something similar would have been way too easy.
lines.zh: : 没什么好道歉的。我只是得自己想办法把这事搞定。要是从另一个有过类似经历的人那儿学点应对方法，那也太容易了。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish20
: Like I said, though...there are things out there that can keep you grounded. And Ami is the biggest one of all.
lines.zh: : 不过就像我说的……外面有东西能让你稳住。而 Ami 是其中最大的那个。

lines.en: if makisex == False:
: Yeah...you’re right.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你说得对。

lines.en: scene black
: I need to get my shit together for her sake.
lines.zh: : 为了她，我得把自己收拾好。

lines.en: : I can’t be hurting right now as all that will do is make things even harder for her.
lines.zh: : 我现在不能陷在痛苦里，因为那只会让她的处境更难。

lines.en: : Exactly...
lines.zh: : 没错……

lines.en: : But that doesn’t mean it’s okay to just give up on yourself either, okay?
lines.zh: : 但这也不代表你就可以干脆放弃自己了，好吗？

lines.en: : Do you understand what I’m saying here? It’s fine to prioritize her. You {i}should{/i} be prioritizing her. But you’re a human as well, Akira. And being upset is, like...the most human thing I can even think of.
lines.zh: : 你明白我的意思吗？把她放在第一位没问题。你是{i}该{/i}把她放在第一位。可你也是个人啊，Akira。而难过……大概是我能想到的最像人类的事情了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I hear you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我听见了。

lines.en: : So you agree that you’ll try and take care of yourself when you really need to?
lines.zh: : 那你是答应了，真的需要的时候会试着照顾好自己？

lines.en: : I’ll see what I can do.
lines.zh: : 我尽量吧。

lines.en: : Akira-
lines.zh: : Akira-

lines.en: : I’ll talk to you later, Maki.
lines.zh: : 我们回头再聊，Maki。

lines.en: : Hah...
: Okay.
: I’ll be here if you need me.
lines.zh: : 你需要我的时候，我就在这儿。

lines.en: scene sky
I make my way back into a space between the trees...
lines.zh: 我走回树与树之间的那片空间……

lines.en: And I think of other ways to kill the time.
lines.zh: 然后开始想别的打发时间的办法。

$ makicamp2 = True
$ maki_love += 1
{i}Maki’s affection has increased to [maki_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maki 的好感度提升到了 [maki_love]!{/i}

lines.en: Now what?
lines.zh: 现在怎么办？

else:
scene makiactualfish21
: But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : You know...I wouldn’t really mind being another one...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……我其实不介意成为另一个……

lines.en: : If Ami’s not enough, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果光有 Ami 还不够的话。

lines.en: : Which isn’t me saying that I think I should be even close to as important in your life as she is, just that I...well...you know...
lines.zh: : 我不是说自己觉得应该在她在你生命里的重要性上占到哪怕一点边，只是我……嗯……你知道的……

lines.en: : Like...you and me are...I kind of...well, like...uhh...how should I put this?
lines.zh: : 比如……你和我……我有点……嗯，就是说……呃……该怎么说呢？

lines.en: : I don’t know, Maki. How {i}should{/i} you put it?
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Maki。你{i}该{/i}怎么说？

lines.en: : Well, it’s...it’s kind of, like...like, it’s no secret that I see you a little differently than the rest of my friends.
lines.zh: : 嗯，就是……就是有点像……就是，我看你的眼光跟看其他朋友不太一样，这已经不是什么秘密了。

lines.en: : And...while it’s not the same way I see Masahiro or...{i}saw{/i} Masahiro...it doesn’t mean you aren’t, like...it doesn’t mean that, uhh...
lines.zh: : 而且……虽然那跟我看 Masahiro 的方式不一样，或者说……{i}看过{/i} Masahiro 的方式不一样……但那也不代表你不是，就是……不代表，呃……

lines.en: scene makiactualfish22
: It doesn’t mean that you...aren’t something I...don’t want to protect.
lines.zh: : 不代表你……不是我想要保护的东西。

lines.en: : That...was too many negatives in one sentence. I need a second to parse-
lines.zh: : 那……一句话里否定词太多了。我得花一秒钟捋一下-

lines.en: : It means you can lean on me because I like you. Okay? There. I said it.
lines.zh: : 意思就是你可以依靠我，因为我喜欢你。好吗？好了。我说出口了。

lines.en: : You didn’t have to say it, Maki. I already knew that.
lines.zh: : 你不用说的，Maki。我早就知道了。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish23
: Then you should have cut me off before I started stammering like that! I’m not good at sounding cute and this is what happens when I try!
lines.zh: : 那你该在我开始结巴之前就打断我啊！我本来就不擅长装可爱，这就是我硬装的下场！

lines.en: : I mean, ignoring how your inability to be cute is what {i}makes{/i} you cute, you shouldn’t feel pressured to say or do things like that.
lines.zh: : 我是说，暂且不提「你装不来可爱这点本身就{i}是{/i}可爱」，你不该觉得有压力非要说或做那种事。

lines.en: : I know you’ll be there if I need you. And just talking to you today has already helped a lot.
lines.zh: : 我知道我需要的时候你会在。光是今天跟你聊了聊，就已经帮了很大的忙。

lines.en: scene makiactualfish24
: Hell, this whole trip has helped a lot and we’ve still got almost a full day ahead of us. So thanks for that. And thanks for giving me the opportunity to...try and make things better.
lines.zh: : 靠，这整趟旅行帮了大忙，而我们前面还有差不多一整天。所以谢谢你。也谢谢你给了我这个机会……去试着把事情变好。

lines.en: scene black
: I can’t promise to lean more on you in the future as...I’m not really in a position now to promise anyone {i}anything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我没法保证以后会更多地依靠你，因为……我现在根本没有立场向任何人保证{i}任何事{/i}。

lines.en: : But you’re important to me as well. And I’m flattered you’d even consider accepting me after falling so hard for someone who fit you so much better.
lines.zh: : 但你对我也很重要。而你曾那么深地爱过一个跟你契合得多的人，却还愿意考虑接受我，这让我受宠若惊。

lines.en: : And I’m flattered you’d consider accepting {i}me{/i} when I’ve had so many penises and penis-shaped objects inside of me that most would consider it a major turn off.
lines.zh: : 而我有那么多鸡巴和鸡巴形状的东西进过我身体，多到大多数人都会觉得是个巨大的扣分点，你却还愿意考虑接受{i}我{/i}，我也很受宠若惊。

lines.en: : And now the moment is ruined.
lines.zh: : 好了，气氛被我毁了。

lines.en: : Ruined? Or {i}better?{/i}
lines.zh: : 毁了？还是{i}更好了{/i}？

lines.en: : Ruined, Maki. Now there’s no way I can have a nice, emotional send off.
lines.zh: : 毁了，Maki。这下我没法来一段温情脉脉的收尾了。

lines.en: : You can’t have a send off at all if I leave first!
lines.zh: : 要是我先走，你连收尾都收不成！

lines.en: : Maki-
lines.zh: : Maki-

lines.en: scene sky
: Bye!
lines.zh: : 拜拜！

lines.en: Maki leaps out of her chair and sprints into the woods, but I’m able to catch a glimpse of how red her face is just before she vanishes into the trees.
lines.zh: Maki 从椅子上跳起来冲进树林，但在她消失在树间之前，我刚好瞥见她的脸有多红。

lines.en: And I think for a moment about why she’d look that way for me.
lines.zh: 我思忖了片刻，她为什么会为我露出那种表情。

lines.en: I think about how {i}my{/i} existence has subtly conned her into believing she could ever squeeze anything out of me that isn’t just semen — and I feel both shameful and regretful as a result of this.
lines.zh: 我想到{i}自己这个人{/i}的存在，如何不动声色地骗得她相信：她能从我这里挤出点什么，而不只是精液——想到这里，我既羞愧又懊悔。

lines.en: I’m ashamed because I doubt I could ever love her.
lines.zh: 我羞愧，是因为我怀疑自己永远不可能爱上她。

lines.en: But I’m regretful to have ever loved at all.
lines.zh: 但我懊悔的，是自己曾经爱过。

lines.en: For life would be so much easier if she were the one I wanted the most.
lines.zh: 因为如果我最想要的人是她，人生会轻松得多。

lines.en: Doubting that Maki will be returning any time soon, I head back to a place between the trees and think of what else to do before the sun sets.
lines.zh: 我估摸着 Maki 一时半会儿不会回来，便回到树与树之间的那个地方，想着日落之前还能干点什么。
